disable.title: Disable module “{name}”?
disable.body: Once disabled, no tenant sees this module in the sidebar and every submodule and permission below it is disabled too. Role assignments are kept and restored when it is re-enabled. Re-enabling only enables this module — submodules must be enabled one by one. This setting affects the whole platform.

matrix.title: {name} — permissions
matrix.subtitle: You can only pass on permissions you hold; "All (*)" covers this module's own level, now and in the future.
matrix.legend: Bold = module (checked = this role can open that page); indented = that module's permissions. "All (*)" and the individual permissions of the same level are linked: checking * brings in the whole level (including future ones); unchecking any one of them releases *.
matrix.shrinkOnly: This role was prepared for you during setup, so its permissions can only shrink — anything it does not already hold cannot be checked.
matrix.ceiling: What this role can be given is capped by the built-in role template — anything the template does not include is greyed out and cannot be checked.
matrix.seedReadOnly: Built-in role: its contents follow the platform version, so this page is view-only.
